assistant:  I can help you to identify foods that are gluten-free and provide alternatives for those that typically contain gluten. Gluten is a protein found in wheat, barley, and rye, so any food products made from these grains will contain gluten. This includes bread, pasta, beer, cakes, cookies, and many processed foods.

When following a gluten-free diet, it's important to read food labels carefully as gluten can be found in unexpected places, such as in soups, sauces, and processed meats. Look for products that are labeled "gluten-free" and choose fresh, whole foods whenever possible.

Here are some gluten-free alternatives to common gluten-containing foods:

* Bread: Look for gluten-free bread made from rice flour, cornmeal, or potato flour. There are also many gluten-free bread mixes available that you can use to make your own bread at home.
* Pasta: Choose pasta made from rice, corn, quinoa, or beans. There are also many gluten-free pasta brands available in grocery stores.
